caption: Select rows within the current Bases query.
eval: (async()=>{for(const dialog of app.plugins.plugins['bases-multi-edit'].dialogs)dialog.close(); app.setting.close();for(let i=0;i<50&&!document.querySelector('.bme-table-view tbody input');i++)await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100));if(!document.querySelector('.bme-table-view tbody input'))throw Error('Table missing');[...document.querySelectorAll('.bme-table-view tbody input')].slice(0,2).forEach(e=>{if(!e.checked)e.click()});return 'selection PASS';})()

caption: Review every old and new value before apply.
eval: (async()=>{for(const dialog of app.plugins.plugins['bases-multi-edit'].dialogs)dialog.close(); app.setting.close();for(let i=0;i<50&&!document.querySelector('.bme-table-view tbody input');i++)await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100));if(!document.querySelector('.bme-table-view tbody input'))throw Error('Table missing');[...document.querySelectorAll('.bme-table-view tbody input')].slice(0,2).forEach(e=>{if(!e.checked)e.click()});[...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(e=>e.textContent==='Edit selected')?.click();await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,300));[...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(e=>e.textContent==='Preview changes')?.click();await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,500)); if(!document.querySelector('.bme-preview pre')) throw Error('Preview missing'); return 'preview PASS';})()

caption: Undo the completed batch in the same session.
eval: (async()=>{[...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(e=>e.textContent==='Apply to 2 notes')?.click();await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,700)); if(!document.querySelector('.bme-preview').textContent.includes('2 notes changed')) throw Error('Apply failed'); return 'apply PASS';})()
after: (async()=>{document.querySelector('.bme-preview button')?.click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,700)); return 'undo PASS';})()

caption: Append a tag without replacing existing list items.
eval: (async()=>{{const row=[...document.querySelectorAll('.modal .setting-item')].find(e=>e.querySelector('.setting-item-name')?.textContent==="Property");const el=row?.querySelector('input,select,textarea');if(!el)throw Error('Missing control');el.value="tags";el.dispatchEvent(new Event(el.tagName==='SELECT'?'change':'input',{bubbles:true}));}{const row=[...document.querySelectorAll('.modal .setting-item')].find(e=>e.querySelector('.setting-item-name')?.textContent==="Operation");const el=row?.querySelector('input,select,textarea');if(!el)throw Error('Missing control');el.value="append";el.dispatchEvent(new Event(el.tagName==='SELECT'?'change':'input',{bubbles:true}));}{const row=[...document.querySelectorAll('.modal .setting-item')].find(e=>e.querySelector('.setting-item-name')?.textContent==="Value type");const el=row?.querySelector('input,select,textarea');if(!el)throw Error('Missing control');el.value="list";el.dispatchEvent(new Event(el.tagName==='SELECT'?'change':'input',{bubbles:true}));}{const row=[...document.querySelectorAll('.modal .setting-item')].find(e=>e.querySelector('.setting-item-name')?.textContent==="Value");const el=row?.querySelector('input,select,textarea');if(!el)throw Error('Missing control');el.value="[\"review\"]";el.dispatchEvent(new Event(el.tagName==='SELECT'?'change':'input',{bubbles:true}));}[...document.querySelectorAll('.modal button')].find(e=>e.textContent==='Preview changes')?.click();await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,400));const text=document.querySelector('.bme-preview pre')?.textContent;if(!text?.includes('review')||!text.includes('null')||!text.includes('project'))throw Error('Missing mixed list preview');return 'append PASS';})()

caption: Remove matching list items and keep the other tags.
eval: (async()=>{[...document.querySelectorAll('.modal button')].find(e=>e.textContent==='Apply to 2 notes')?.click();await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,700));if(!document.querySelector('.bme-preview').textContent.includes('2 notes changed'))throw Error('Append failed');{const row=[...document.querySelectorAll('.modal .setting-item')].find(e=>e.querySelector('.setting-item-name')?.textContent==="Operation");const el=row?.querySelector('input,select,textarea');if(!el)throw Error('Missing control');el.value="remove-items";el.dispatchEvent(new Event(el.tagName==='SELECT'?'change':'input',{bubbles:true}));}[...document.querySelectorAll('.modal button')].find(e=>e.textContent==='Preview changes')?.click();await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,400));if(!document.querySelector('.bme-preview pre')?.textContent.includes('review'))throw Error('Missing remove preview');return 'remove PASS';})()
after: (async()=>{[...document.querySelectorAll('.bme-toolbar button')].find(e=>e.textContent==='Undo last batch')?.click();await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,700));return 'restored append';})()

caption: Replace one tag with another tag in place on the selected rows.
eval: (async()=>{for(const dialog of app.plugins.plugins['bases-multi-edit'].dialogs)dialog.close(); app.setting.close();for(let i=0;i<50&&!document.querySelector('.bme-table-view tbody input');i++)await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100));const root=document.querySelector('.bme-table-view');if(!root)throw Error('Table missing');[...root.querySelectorAll('button')].find(e=>e.textContent==='Select visible')?.click();await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,200));[...document.querySelector('.bme-table-view').querySelectorAll('button')].find(e=>e.textContent==='Edit selected')?.click();await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,300));for(const [name,value] of Object.entries({Property:'tags',Operation:'replace-items','Value type':'list','Find items':'["project"]',Value:'["area"]'})){const row=[...document.querySelectorAll('.modal .setting-item')].find(e=>e.querySelector('.setting-item-name')?.textContent===name);const el=row?.querySelector('input,select,textarea');if(!el)throw Error('Missing control '+name);el.value=value;el.dispatchEvent(new Event(el.tagName==='SELECT'?'change':'input',{bubbles:true}));}[...document.querySelectorAll('.modal button')].find(e=>e.textContent==='Preview changes')?.click();await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,500));const text=document.querySelector('.bme-preview pre')?.textContent??'';if(!text.includes('"project" → "area"')||!text.includes('["project"] → ["area"]'))throw Error('Missing replace preview');document.querySelector('.bme-preview pre').scrollIntoView({block:'end'});await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,200));return 'replace PASS';})()
